configuration: Both upstream cases of unittest/tree-broadphase.cpp: an empty model, then the broad-phase answer compared against the pair-by-pair answer over a batch of configurations. The deck is the ur5 robot description vendored with the pinned source at code/pinocchio/models/example-robot-data/robots/ur_description/, an arm of six revolute joints carrying seven triangle-mesh collision objects and one box, parsed by the URDF geometry parser exactly as upstream parses its own deck. Upstream runs this case on romeo_small.urdf from the romeo_description package, which is not vendored under code/pinocchio/; the ur description is, with its collision meshes, and it is the deck the module's own upstream example uses. The configuration and the batch are read from ic/<ic>/operands.json; upstream draws the batch from randomConfiguration, which takes the unseeded std::rand stream inside the module a solver would port. The batch is 16 configurations rather than upstream's 1000. Graded: the world axis-aligned bounding box of every collision object of every sub-manager, named after the joint that owns the sub-manager and the geometry object the box bounds.
observable: the world bounding box of every collision object, read from the sub-manager of the joint that owns it
default_vs_upstream: the ur5 description and its SRDF in place of romeo's, the configuration and the batch as initial conditions in ic/, and a batch of 16 configurations rather than 1000
variant: Two units in the last place, toward positive infinity, on every nonzero number of ic/nominal/operands.json; the zeros are left as they are, because two ulps above zero is a subnormal, which is not a perturbation of a length, an angle or a quaternion coordinate. Perturbing every nonzero component rather than one component per quantity is deliberate: on an earlier Pinocchio leaf, moving a single entry of a rotation rounded away in an output built from all nine and left dozens of observables with a spread of exactly zero, while moving all of them is still a two-ulp calibration. Here that is the nonzero coordinates of the configuration and of all sixteen configurations of the batch. All 221 numbers of ic/nominal/operands.json move; none of them is zero. The worst measured spread over all 816 graded values is 1.1102e-15 absolute.
altbuild: none: the same source built at -O0 with -ffp-contract=off reproduces the -O2 -DNDEBUG result bit-identically for every graded value of this check, so an alternative build measures a floor of exactly zero and supplies no evidence. The graded quantities are rigid transform compositions and geometric distances between fixed shapes; Eigen fixes the evaluation order of the expressions, the loops are scalar, and coal's shape queries are closed form or an exhaustive minimum over a fixed set of features, so the compiler has nothing to reassociate. The alternative build was nevertheless run for every check of this leaf rather than assumed, because on an earlier Pinocchio leaf it was what exposed a graded buffer that was reading uninitialised memory.

evidence.floor_how: The same official.cpp compiled twice against the same pinned library, once at -O2 -DNDEBUG and once at -O0 -ffp-contract=off, and run on ic/nominal; every graded value was bit-identical, so the measured floor is 0.0 and the bound is set from the variant spread and the physics instead.

warrant: The graded quantity is the world axis-aligned bounding box of one collision object, its lower and upper corner in metres in the world Cartesian axes, read out of the sub-manager belonging to the joint that carries it. Each record is named after that joint and that geometry object, both fixed by the model, so nothing is compared by a slot an implementation may permute. The bound is 1e-09 absolute plus 1e-11 relative, so on the largest graded magnitude here, about 1.78e+00, it admits about 1.02e-09. It is physical because every implementation fault the tree broad phase can express is many orders of magnitude larger: an object filed under the wrong joint, a sub-manager not refreshed when its joint moved, or a box left in the shape's local frame changes a corner by between 1e-02 and 1e+00 m, seven to nine decades above the bound, and the naming makes a misfiled object a missing record rather than a near-miss. The upstream assertions stay active as well, including the agreement between the tree-broad-phase and pair-by-pair answers over the whole batch. It is achievable because a correct port that reassociates these compositions differs by about a few units in the last place of the largest intermediate, some 1e-15 in these units, six decades inside the bound, and because the alternative build measured exactly zero. Measured on this host: the two-ulp variant moves the worst graded value by 1.1102e-15, using 1.098e-06 of the bound, that is 911,021 times of headroom across all 816 graded values; and every graded value scaled by 0.1 per cent, a fault far smaller than any this test can express, is rejected at 1,746,295 times the bound. The bound is loose enough for a genuinely different implementation on another device and tight enough that no fault the upstream test is written to catch could pass it.
